title: Pairing
description: pairing/{code}, where code is 8 characters from 23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ (no look-alikes). Opened by the device for at most 10 minutes. Claimed once by a caregiver, in one batch that sets claimedBy to their uid, adds that uid to devices/{deviceId}.caregivers and sets devices/{deviceId}.pairingCode to this code.
